Practice Area 08

Mergers & Restructuring

Strategic corporate restructuring, tax-optimized scheme execution, and comprehensive due diligence.

Partner-Led Delivery

Overview & Scope of Practice

Sections 230–232 corporate schemes, Section 233 fast-track mergers, demergers, due diligence, tax impact analysis, and valuer coordination.

At Y K Chaturvedi & Co., assignments in mergers & restructuring are managed with strict statutory compliance, digital accuracy, and direct partner supervision to insulate your organization from regulatory non-compliance, litigation risks, and penalties.

Scope of Services Included6 Specialized Areas

Mergers, amalgamations and demergers under Sections 230–232 of the Companies Act, 2013
Fast-track mergers under Section 233 (small companies, start-ups, holding–subsidiary)
Due diligence, accounting and tax impact analysis, and coordination with valuers and legal counsel
Financial modeling for swap ratio determinations
NCLT and Regional Director representation support
Stamp duty analysis and post-merger integration of accounts

Key Strategic Benefits & Value

01

Fast-Track Section 233 Efficiency

Save significant time and court costs through administrative fast-track mergers between holding-subsidiary or small companies.

02

Tax-Neutral Structuring

Structuring amalgamations to meet Section 47 exemption criteria under the Income-tax law to eliminate capital gains tax.

03

Deep Financial Due Diligence

Uncover hidden liabilities, tax exposures, and operational risks before finalizing transactional agreements.

04

Integrated Multi-Disciplinary Coordination

Seamless synchronization between registered valuers, legal counsels, and statutory regulators.

Our Structured Execution Methodology

Phase 01
Feasibility & Structure Design

Assessing commercial objectives, tax implications, and determining whether fast-track or NCLT route applies.

Phase 02
Valuation & Swap Ratio

Collaborating with Registered Valuers to compute fair share exchange ratios and drafting scheme.

Phase 03
Approvals & Filings

Securing board, creditor, and shareholder consents; filing scheme with RD, ROC, and Official Liquidator.

Phase 04
Sanction & Amalgamation

Obtaining confirmation order, filing INC-28, and executing post-merger balance sheet consolidation.

Frequently Asked Questions: Mergers & Restructuring

Section 233 provides an expeditious merger procedure without approaching the NCLT for mergers between two or more small companies, or between a holding company and its wholly-owned subsidiary, approved by the Regional Director (RD).
